text:
Erica: Thanks for joining the quick follow-up thread. One question each on GPU supply, regional rollouts, and autoscaler behavior. Keep it short.
Sam: Topline: Q2 hosted pool healthy but APAC quota spikes remain our main operational risk. We've negotiated a small committed pool in SG as a stopgap and an EU buffer for customer-critical routes.
Priya: For customers on Dedicated, will we change reservation terms if we need to move capacity across regions?
Vikram: No unilateral changes to contracts. For Dedicated we'll offer an explicit "cross-region failover" opt-in during onboarding and a toggled option in the account console. Ops will only actuate with approval.
Lina: Autoscaler concern: nodal oscillation during promotional traffic. Any config tweaks planned?
Sam: Yes  two mitigations: (1) short spike absorb (token bucket ~30s) to avoid scale events for blips; (2) stepwise scale with cooldown backoff instead of big jumps. We'll post exact params.
Vikram: Also adding a model-variant fallback: when GPU capacity is constrained, routing policy can prefer a quantized variant within the same region before spilling to another region. That keeps latency predictable.
Priya: How will we telegraph a spill to customers? We need per-request visibility for debugging.
Sam: Console + traces: every request will include served_region, model_variant, and fallback_reason. We'll add an alert when spillover > 3% over a 10m window.
Erica: Procurement update? Any notable lead-time changes for H100 vs A100?
Vikram: A100 reorder ETA ~8 weeks. H100 lead time still more variable due to kernel validation; target Q3 for broader H100 presence but small pilot reservations may land earlier.
Lina: Runbook ownership for emergency capacity bumps? Who's on the hook?
Sam: Capacity-ops coordinates reserves; infra-oncall executes. We'll make a Slack shortcut that pings capacity-ops and kicks off a short checklist. Lina to own the runbook update.
ops-bot: :gear: Autoscaler experiment as-layered deployed to staging. Monitor: https://dash.internal/canaries/as-layered-exp
Priya: Request: please document billing implications when a route spills to another region. Accounts team needs a clear FAQ.
Sam: Will do. We'll annotate billing and add a customer-facing note in the onboarding flow.
Erica: Actions: Sam -> billing FAQ + procurement note; Vikram -> autoscaler params + fallback policy PR; Lina -> runbook update + Slack shortcut; Priya -> coordinate account comms. Reconvene next Tues.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Actions recorded: sam/billing-faq, vikram/autoscaler-pr, lina/runbook, priya/account-comms
Sam: Thanks team  I'll follow up with links in #eng-ops.
